notes.title: Marble Land Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here are the main improvements included in this update:

 Added snap turning with adjustable angles
 Added teleport movement
 Added "Grab and pull" locomotion
 Switched to using 4x MSAA instead of FXAA for a crisper look in VR
 Support for WMR(Windows Mixed Reality) headsets through SteamVR
 Translation for the following languages: French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese(Simplified), Russian


Stay tuned for more to come!
